body.name: Pure-private pair test and estimator
body.construction: Compute \(S_{\mathrm{pair}}(D_n)\), draw \(W\sim\operatorname{Laplace}(8/(3\epsilon))\), return \(\phi_{\mathrm{pair}}=\operatorname{sign}\{S_{\mathrm{pair}}(D_n)+W\}\) with an independent fair tie-break at zero, and set \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{pair}}=-\phi_{\mathrm{pair}}ab/(1/4-a^2)\).
